subtitle: From Feudatory to Founder: Tailapa and the Shattering of Rashtrakuta Power

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of Tailapa_ii standing over a toppled crown on the Deccan plain at dusk
panels.action: Tailapa II stands tall on a dusty Deccan rise, one foot near a fallen jeweled crown, the distant silhouette of Manyakheta smouldering under a blood-red sky.

dialogue.text: In the shadow of a shattered Rashtrakuta crown, feudatory Tailapa of Tardavadi seizes a ruined moment and forges a new Chalukya power in the northern Deccan.

i18n.hi: टूटी राश्ट्रकूट मुकुट की छाया में, तारदवाड़ी का जागीरदार तैलप इस बर्बाद घड़ी को पकड़कर उत्तरी दक्खिन में नई चालुक्य ताकत गढ़ता है।

panels.shot: slow push-in towards Tailapa_ii seated with scribes in a modest feudatory court
panels.action: In a modest hall hung with Rashtrakuta emblems, Tailapa II sits on a lesser throne, conferring with scribes over copper plates as courtiers watch in respectful silence.

dialogue.text: Our story opens not with a king, but with a feudatory. Tailapa of Tardavadi, named in copper-plate grants of 957 and 965, serves the Rashtrakutas who still rule the Deccan.

i18n.hi: कहानी शुरू होती है राजा से नहीं, एक जागीरदार से। तारदवाड़ी का तैलप, ९५७ और ९६५ की ताम्रपट्टियों में नामित, दक्खिन पर राज कर रहे राश्ट्रकूटों की सेवा करता है।

panels.shot: documentary close-up on a copper plate being engraved, Tailapa_ii’s hand resting nearby
panels.action: A craftsman engraves Sanskrit and Kannada lines onto a gleaming copper plate as Tailapa’s steady hand rests on the table, his ring bearing a simple Chalukya-style emblem.

dialogue.text: Karjol and Narasalagi records call him a loyal officer of Tardavadi-1000, guarding lands and revenues under his Rashtrakuta overlord. The future emperor is still just a name in metal.

i18n.hi: कर्जोल और नरसालगी अभिलेख उसे तारदवाड़ी-१००० का वफादार अफसर बताते हैं, जो अपने राश्ट्रकूट स्वामी के नीचे जमीन और राजस्व की रखवाली करता है। भावी सम्राट अभी बस धातु पर खुदा एक नाम है।

panels.shot: wide shot of Tailapa_ii inspecting troops in the countryside, Rashtrakuta banners flying
panels.action: On a dry field near a village, Tailapa rides along a row of spear-bearing soldiers under Rashtrakuta standards, his face calm but watchful as farmers pause to look on.

dialogue.text: As feudatory, Tailapa commands men and marches for his masters. Yet he stands on a frontier of change; the Rashtrakuta empire, once mighty from Manyakheta to Gujarat, is fraying at the edges.

i18n.hi: जागीरदार होकर तैलप फौजें संभालता है, मालिकों के लिए कूच करता है। पर वह बदलाव की सीमा पर खड़ा है; मन्याकेट से गुजरात तक फैला कभी शक्तिशाली राश्ट्रकूट साम्राज्य किनारों से उधड़ रहा है।

panels.shot: dramatic bird’s-eye of Manyakheta under attack at night
panels.action: The great city of Manyakheta sprawls beneath the stars, its palaces lit by fire as invading forces pour through broken gates, smoke rising over temple towers and royal halls.

dialogue.text: Then, in 972, disaster. Siyaka of the Paramaras strikes Manyakheta, the Rashtrakuta capital. Inscriptions and chronicles remember a sack that shakes their throne to its foundations.

i18n.hi: फिर ९७२ में, विनाश। परमार राजा सियाक मन्याकेट, राश्ट्रकूट राजधानी, पर धावा बोलता है। अभिलेख और कथाएँ उस लूट को याद करती हैं जिसने सिंहासन की जड़ें हिला दीं।

panels.shot: somber interior wide of a plundered palace hall with deserted throne
panels.action: A once-splendid throne room lies in disarray, pillars scorched, ornaments missing, the Rashtrakuta throne standing empty beneath a cracked frieze of faded royal glory.

dialogue.text: The crown survives, but its aura is broken. The Rashtrakuta Karka II inherits a shaken capital, restless feudatories and a memory of humiliation that cannot be easily erased.

i18n.hi: मुकुट बच जाता है, पर उसका तेज टूट चुका है। राश्ट्रकूट कार्क द्वितीय को हिली हुई राजधानी, बेचैन जागीरदार और अपमान की याद विरासत में मिलती है जो आसानी से मिटती नहीं।

panels.shot: medium shot of Tailapa_ii in his court, lit by a shaft of light, listening to news of Manyakheta
panels.action: Messengers kneel before Tailapa in his hall, recounting the sack with urgent gestures as a shaft of sunlight cuts across Tailapa's thoughtful, unsmiling face.

dialogue.text: To men like Tailapa, the shock is also an opening. A feudatory watching from Tardavadi sees imperial weakness, hears of discontent, and quietly weighs what might now be possible.

i18n.hi: तैलप जैसे लोगों के लिए यह सदमा एक मौका भी है। तारदवाड़ी से देखता यह जागीरदार साम्राज्य की कमजोरी देखता है, असंतोष की खबरें सुनता है और चुपचाप सोचता है कि अब क्या मुमकिन है।

panels.shot: intense close-up on Tailapa_ii’s eyes, background fading to darkness
panels.action: Tailapa sits alone, the court dimmed, his eyes lit by a single lamp as the bustle outside fades, leaving his face caught between duty and a fierce, emerging resolve.

dialogue.speaker: tailapa_ii
dialogue.text: If their crown trembles, shall Tardavadi tremble with it…or rise?

i18n.hi: अगर उनका मुकुट डगमगाए, तो क्या तारदवाड़ी भी साथ डगमगाए…या उठ खड़ा हो?

panels.shot: wide shot of Tailapa_ii addressing his captains in a courtyard at dawn
panels.action: At dawn, under pale skies, Tailapa stands on a stone platform in his fort courtyard, speaking to a ring of armed captains whose faces show doubt, fear and a quiet eagerness.

dialogue.text: Around 973, the record turns. Scholars read in scattered inscriptions a revolt: Tailapa moves from serving Karka II to overthrowing him, using the post-sack turmoil as his blade.

i18n.hi: लगभग ९७३ के आसपास अभिलेखों का सुर बदलता है। बिखरे शिलालेखों में विद्रोह दिखता है: तैलप कार्क द्वितीय की सेवा छोड़ उससे लड़ने को उठता है, लूट के बाद की उथल-पुथल को अपनी तलवार बनाकर।

panels.shot: dynamic battlefield wide, Tailapa_ii’s cavalry surging toward a Rashtrakuta standard
panels.action: On an open Deccan plain, Tailapa leads cavalry in a dust-raising charge toward a hill where the Rashtrakuta banner flies, spears leveled, his cloak whipping in the wind.

dialogue.text: The clash itself is barely sketched in stone, but the outcome is clear. By the mid-970s, Karka II falls. Tailapa stands where Rashtrakuta kings once sat, claiming Manyakheta and new authority.

i18n.hi: टक्कर खुद पत्थर पर साफ नहीं उकेरी, पर नतीजा साफ है। ९७० के दशक के बीच तक कार्क द्वितीय गिरता है। तैलप वहीं खड़ा है जहाँ राश्ट्रकूट राजा बैठते थे, मन्याकेट और नई सत्ता पर दावा करता हुआ।

panels.shot: ceremonial interior shot of Tailapa_ii ascending the Rashtrakuta throne for the first time
panels.action: Tailapa climbs the steps of the Rashtrakuta throne in Manyakheta, courtiers bowing as he turns, sits, and looks out over the hall with a composed yet measuring gaze.

dialogue.text: From feudatory of Tardavadi, he becomes king in his own right. This is the birth of the Western Chalukyas of Kalyani, a new line that later inscriptions will trace back to older Chalukya fame.

i18n.hi: तारदवाड़ी के जागीरदार से वह खुद का राजा बन जाता है। यही कल्याणी के पश्चिमी चालुक्यों का जन्म है, नई वंशावली जिसे बाद के अभिलेख पुराने चालुक्य यश से जोड़ते हैं।

panels.shot: close shot of Tailapa_ii listening to a court poet recite, with palm-leaf manuscript visible
panels.action: In a refined court setting, Tailapa sits at ease as a Kannada poet holds a palm-leaf and recites, the air rich with incense and the murmur of scribes and ministers.

dialogue.text: By 982, Ranna’s Gada Yuddha praises Tailapa and links him to the old Badami Chalukyas. Modern historians treat this descent as political genealogy, a crafted story to dress new power in ancient robes.

i18n.hi: ९८२ तक रन्ना की ‘गदा युद्ध’ तैलप की प्रशंसा करती है और उसे पुराने बादामी चालुक्यों से जोड़ती है। आधुनिक इतिहासकार इस वंशावली को राजनीतिक रचना मानते हैं, जो नई ताकत को प्राचीन चोला पहनाती है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Tailapa_ii with a map of the Deccan spread before him
panels.action: Tailapa leans over a painted cloth map showing the Deccan, placing weights on key regions as advisors point toward the north and west where rival kings hold sway.

dialogue.text: Tailapa’s work is only beginning. To hold his crown he must face neighbours who remember Rashtrakuta weakness and test this upstart Chalukya power in war and diplomacy.

i18n.hi: तैलप का काम अभी शुरू ही हुआ है। मुकुट संभालने को उसे उन पड़ोसियों का सामना करना होगा जो राश्ट्रकूट कमजोरी याद रखते हैं और युद्ध व कूटनीति में इस नए चालुक्य बल को परखेंगे।

panels.shot: wide shot of camp at night with Tailapa_ii and generals planning, torches flickering
panels.action: Under a starry sky in a field camp, Tailapa and his generals bend over plans by torchlight, the silhouettes of tents, horses and watch-fires stretching into the dark.

dialogue.text: Among these rivals stands Munja, the Paramara king whose line had once struck Manyakheta itself. Their contest becomes crucial for Tailapa’s standing in the wider Deccan.

i18n.hi: इन प्रतिद्वंद्वियों में मुंज खड़ा है, वही परमार राजा जिसकी वंश ने कभी मन्याकेट को ही चोट पहुंचाई थी। उनका संघर्ष तैलप की दक्खिन में हैसियत तय करने वाला बन जाता है।

panels.shot: tense battlefield wide showing captured enemy king flanked by Tailapa_ii’s forces
panels.action: On a trampled battlefield, Tailapa’s soldiers surround a bound, proud-looking captive king, while Tailapa watches from horseback, the air heavy with dust and silent tension.

dialogue.text: The chronicles speak of Munja’s defeat and later killing. For Tailapa’s regime this is more than victory; it announces that the new Chalukya state can humble the very power that once humbled Manyakheta.

i18n.hi: कथाएँ मुंज की हार और बाद में उसके मारे जाने की बात करती हैं। तैलप की सत्ता के लिए यह सिर्फ जीत नहीं; ऐलान है कि नई चालुक्य राज्य उस ताकत को झुका सकता है जिसने कभी मन्याकेट को झुकाया था।

panels.shot: grand wide shot of Tailapa_ii in a more splendid hall at Kalyani, receiving envoys
panels.action: In an ornate hall in Kalyani, Tailapa sits on a richly carved throne as envoys from other kingdoms approach with gifts, pillars bearing freshly painted Chalukya motifs.

dialogue.text: With Munja’s fall and Rashtrakuta collapse behind him, Tailapa’s court gains weight. Envoys and poets now address him as founder of a rising Chalukya power, not merely as a fortunate rebel.

i18n.hi: मुंज के पतन और राश्ट्रकूटों के ढहने के बाद तैलप का दरबार भारी हो जाता है। अब दूत और कवि उसे उठती चालुक्य शक्ति के जनक मानकर संबोधित करते हैं, सिर्फ भाग्यशाली बागी नहीं।

panels.shot: reflective medium shot of Tailapa_ii looking out over the Deccan from a fort rampart at sunset
panels.action: Tailapa stands on the ramparts of his fort at sunset, looking out over fields and distant hills as wind tugs at his garments and the sky fades from gold to deep blue.

dialogue.text: The Western Chalukyas will rule from the late tenth century into the twelfth, shaping Deccan politics and law. Their story begins with one man reading the moment when an older empire stumbles.

i18n.hi: पश्चिमी चालुक्य देर दसवीं सदी से बारहवीं तक राज करेंगे, दक्खिन की राजनीति और कानून को आकार देंगे। उनकी कहानी शुरू होती है एक आदमी से जो देखता है कि पुराना साम्राज्य कब लड़खड़ाता है।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on Tailapa_ii’s weathered profile, background hinting at inscriptions and cityscapes
panels.action: Tailapa’s profile fills the frame, his features weathered yet calm, while faint images of copper-plate inscriptions and city skylines of Manyakheta and Kalyani blur behind him.

dialogue.text: Tailapa II did not inherit an ancient Chalukya right so much as carve a new one from Rashtrakuta ruin. His rise reminds us that states are born where timing meets resolve—and where records remember the risk.

i18n.hi: तैलप द्वितीय को कोई प्राचीन चालुक्य अधिकार विरासत में कम मिला, उसने राश्ट्रकूट खंडहर से नया अधिकार तराशा। उसका उदय याद दिलाता है कि राज्य वहीं जन्म लेते हैं जहाँ समय और जिगर मिलते हैं—और जहाँ अभिलेख उस जोखिम को दर्ज करते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.en: From Feudatory to Founder: Tailapa and the Shattering of Rashtrakuta Power
subtitle_i18n.hi: जागीरदार से जनक तक: तैलप और राश्ट्रकूट शक्ति का चकनाचूर होना
